classification.notes: The article is a headline-only notice of a proposed NYSE rule change amending Rule 7.18 on trading halts. While trading halts could theoretically relate to XE-DISRUPT, this is a routine administrative/regulatory filing to amend the procedural rules governing how trading halts are conducted — not a report of an actual exchange halt, declared emergency, or unscheduled market closure. There is no outside event described that touches a DTCC process; it is a self-regulatory organization rule amendment with no risk event content.
